Art N'lagje, residential residence represents high standards of construction and contemporary architecture, offering a quality and comfortable living environment. The area is quiet and green, with recreational parks and well-organized common spaces for residents. * Main features: -Building under construction with 17 floors and 3 underground floors (currently on the 7th floor) -Modern facade with thermal insulation -Functional division and usable space -Elevator and well managed common areas.
